content.thinking: Now let me test with the launch.py harness against the sanity fixture.

arguments.command:
cd /workspace && python3 launch.py < examples/sanity.json > /workspace/tmp/out.json; echo "exit=$?"; python3 - <<'EOF'
import json
a=json.load(open('/workspace/tmp/out.json'))
b=json.load(open('/workspace/examples/sanity.expected.json'))
print(json.dumps(a,separators=(',',':')))
def same(x,y,path=''):
    if type(x)!=type(y): print('type',path,x,y); return False
    if isinstance(x,dict):
        if set(x)!=set(y): print('keys',path,set(x),set(y)); return False
        return all(same(x[k],y[k],path+'/'+k) for k in x)
    if isinstance(x,list):
        if len(x)!=len(y): print('len',path,len(x),len(y)); return False
        return all(same(u,v,path+'/%d'%i) for i,(u,v) in enumerate(zip(x,y)))
    if x!=y: print('val',path,x,y); return False
    return True
print('MATCH', same(a,b))
EOF
